title: Code and data for: Do neural-network free-energy surfaces know when they are wrong? Calibrated uncertainty for free-energy landscapes learned from mean forces
description:
Code, simulation data and results for a calibration study of uncertainty estimates for free-energy surfaces learned from mean forces. Neural-network ensembles (random initialization, bootstrap, noise injection, with and without held-out-label rescaling) and a gradient-observation Gaussian process are tested against known truth on a 2D and a 4D model with exact free energies and on alanine dipeptide in vacuum (OpenMM) referenced to four independent well-tempered metadynamics runs.

Includes all source code, the metadynamics reference free-energy surfaces, per-replica raw results and summaries for every experiment, run logs, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the manuscript.
